Scope & interpretation · PO years 2022–2024. Values reflect workbook records, not live balances. Currency is filtered, never converted. Cancelled orders are excluded by default. Net spend is PO value, not cash paid.
KPI definitions & data notesNet spend = sum of Line Net (after discounts, before tax). Suppliers = distinct Supplier ID in the selected scope. Budget savings = sum of Savings Amount; weighted rate = savings / Budget Total. On-time delivery = records marked Yes / selected PO records. Average lead time = mean Lead Time Days. Payment bottlenecks use Payment Status; invoice disputes use Invoice Status; delivery delays use Days Late > 0. Associated PO value is not an outstanding balance, and statuses are not time-aged against today's date. No approval timestamps are available, so approval-cycle bottlenecks cannot be measured. Supplier attributes may vary across records; high-risk exposure is evaluated per record. All 5,200 source rows have unique PO numbers and no missing cells. Supplier scorecard is limited to selected currency; suppliers may also transact in other currencies.
